items.title: Berkshire Stock Rally Has Room to Run. Apple and Coke Are Driving Portfolio Gains.
items.summary: Berkshire’s equity portfolio is having a strong year to date performance, led by Apple—its largest holding—and Coca-Cola.

items.title: UP, Norfolk Southern Sweeten Merger Proposal With New Customer Protections
items.summary: The new commitments include expanded gateway pricing and temporary access to competing rail service if performance slips after the merger.

items.title: Union Pacific, Norfolk Southern File Supplemental Information to STB on Merger
items.summary: The companies added commitments, including expanded gateway pricing, to ensure the combined railroad will provide faster, more reliable service as promised.

items.title: How Much Union Pacific (UNP) Are You Really Betting On?

items.title: UNP vs. NSC: One Is a Growth Play, the Other a Merger Bet

While both companies reported strong results, NSC’s investment case is now tied to the possible acquisition. Investors must weigh UNP’s standalone growth potential against NSC’s risks […]

items.title: Canadian National won’t fight UP-NS merger under new deal
items.summary: The deal would provide Canadian National with access to shipper sites that would face reduced Class I railroad offerings, pending STB approval.
